subject.title: [Bug] Agent context window fragmentation during concurrent subagent tool calls

question: Should OpenClaw retain completion-order delivery only, or add an explicit opt-in ordered join for a named set of child run IDs?
rationale: Ordering changes when completed results become visible and determines how stalled or failed children affect later results, so source inspection cannot safely choose the contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep push completion
options.body: Retain identity-bearing completion events in completion order and require a wrong-child reproduction before treating this as a bug.

options.title: Add ordered join
options.body: Add a separate opt-in operation that waits for named child run IDs and returns their results in caller-specified order.

recommendation.title: Keep push completion
recommendation.body: Retain identity-bearing completion events in completion order and require a wrong-child reproduction before treating this as a bug.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work is the closest history signal for grouped completion and requester-session delivery behavior.
